attestations.text: Chu Hsi-wei 朱錫緯, died about 1782 at the age of twenty-two sui, but left a son, Chu T'u 朱涂, who was made an honorary chü-jên in 1800. The daughter married Fêng Ping-ch'ien 馮秉騝 (T. 健一), a native of T'ung-chou, Chihli, a senior licentiate of 1777, and magistrate of Chang-yeh, Kansu (ca.
